headline: Quiet Sunday closes a darker month
body: Another day without scored news. Lines drifted by a hundredth or two as earlier stories faded, and Horizon Balance holds at -6.76. The month ends with Enslaved God on 42.51, Conquerors on 30.41 and Self-Destruction on 26.74.
movers_note: No ending moved by a tenth of a point; only fading earlier events, at 0.01 to 0.02 each.
